core_obligations: (1)=>(2): completion preserves unramifiedness for local homomorphisms: B^ finite over A^ (accepted lemma-unramified-completions (1)), the maximal ideals identify via faithful flatness (argued), and Omega_B/A tensor to Omega of the completion; conclude via the Algebra characterize-unramified criterion.

(2)=>(3): a local unramified homomorphism of local rings is unramified as a homomorphism: B^ finite over A^ => finite presentation; unramified at the closed point plus Algebra unramified-at-prime openness gives unramified everywhere (accepted pair + Algebra).
(3)=>(2): unramified at all primes in particular at the maximal pair; the local homomorphism of completions is unramified (argued via the same faithful-flatness identification).
proof_roadmap: (1)<=>(2): faithful flatness of completion + maximal-ideal identification + Omega criterion (argued) + accepted completions pair; (2)=>(3): finite=>fp + Algebra unramified-at-prime; (3)=>(2): restriction to the closed point.
